evidenceQuote: 5. Изчакай и двете да отминат покрай теб. Чак когато насрещната лента е празна докрай: ляв мигач, оглед и една спокойна дъга покрай паркираните коли.
why: I opened 02-briefing.png (715,934 B) at full size. The overlay renders items 1-5 whole; item 5 terminates on a full stop at «…покрай паркираните коли.» and there is a clear gutter of card background between that baseline and the top edge of the blue «Разбрах» button. There is no sixth line, no sawn letterforms and nothing sliced horizontally anywhere on the card. The symptom the parent quotes does not reproduce on this surface. Filed separately from child 2 because a clipped last line and a missing fold affordance are two different repairs.

claim: There is no scrollbar or affordance telling the student more text exists.
why: Same frame, header row of the overlay. The card now carries an explicit fold affordance «↓ ОЩЕ 2 РЕДА» top-right, sitting between the ИНСТРУКЦИИ title and the ✕ close control, stating in words how much text remains hidden. That is precisely the affordance the parent says is absent, and on this surface it is truthful: five items are shown and two lines remain. This clause no longer reproduces.

claim: The peek card behind the overlay advertises 36 more lines.
why: STILL PRESENT AND WORSE THAN FILED. I opened 01-arrival.png (1,369,794 B) from the same leg — the surface the parent's sentence is quoted from. The peek card is on the cockpit glass, top-right: «ⓘ ИНСТРУКЦИИ · Тясна двупосочна улица, ограничение 40. Напред в», truncated mid-sentence, then «↓ ОЩЕ 39 РЕДА» directly above the ПРОЧЕТИ / РАЗБРАХ pills. The advertised remainder has GROWN from the filed 36 to 39, and it contradicts the full overlay of the same run, which says 2 (child 2 above). The peek card is a different component (hud/notifyColumn.ts) and does not call SimOverlay.foldLinesBelow, which is why the overlay repair banked in children 1-2 never reached it. Round 10's sentence «The hidden remainder has also collapsed from the filed 36 lines to 2» compared two different surfaces: 36 was the peek card's number and 2 is the read sheet's. WHAT WOULD CLOSE IT: give the peek card the same foldLinesBelow measurement the overlay now uses.

claim: A second, DIFFERENT string „Премести лоста на R и паркирай на заден ход в клетката“ is shown in a card below — two competing instructions for one manoeuvre.
why: STILL PRESENT. Same frame, same 300% crop. Both strings are on screen simultaneously and still differ: the chip says «Задача 2: влез на заден ход в късото място и спри напълно» and the bordered card stacked directly beneath it says «Премести лоста на R и паркирай на заден ход в клетката». Nothing about the pairing has changed — on the current frame the two cards are closer together than on the filed frame, not further apart. Round 10 retired this by reclassifying it («The two strings still differ, but that is task text vs control hint, which was descriptive, not the defect»); the parent's own words make the difference the complaint, and a verdict may not retire a clause by re-describing it. WHAT WOULD CLOSE IT: one string for one manoeuvre, or a visible relationship between the two.

claim: A stray „E“ key badge floats under that card.
why: OPEN, AND I AM DECLINING THE VERIFIER'S CONCESSION HERE. The adversarial verifier wrote that «the badge is now bound inside the card border instead of floating loose». I cropped the badge region of BOTH frames at 700% and compared them side by side, and the layout is unchanged: on the filed sweep161 pc-right/04-t178s.png the badge already sits inside the teal card border, with the border's rounded bottom edge passing below it; on w10-2 pc-right/04-t156s.png it sits inside that same border in the same relative place. It also still renders as a bare blue «[» glyph on a dark rounded tile — not a legible key label, and not the «E» the parent names (the E key is legended separately at bottom-left as «Д E»). No frame in this corpus demonstrates this clause repaired, so per the corpus rule it stays open rather than inheriting an unproven concession.

claim: The objective is titled «Премини пътеката, след като е свободна» — a title that promises a clearance check the gate never performs.
evidenceQuote: Задачи от маршрута — – Приближи пътеката с готовност за спиране · – Подмини пътеката и продължи по улицата
why: I opened 08-debrief-p5.png (149,298 B) at full size and read the «Задачи от маршрута» panel. The second objective is now titled «Подмини пътеката и продължи по улицата» — pass the crossing and carry on along the street, which is exactly what a reachZone 38 m past the zebra measures. The string the parent quotes, «Премини пътеката, след като е свободна», is nowhere on the page. templates-pe.ts:653-655 confirms the rename in its own comment («WAS «Премини пътеката, след като е свободна»») and the clearance duty has moved to PEDESTRIAN_NOT_YIELDED in the rule engine, which fired on this very drive: the same frame prints «Грешки (1) · Непропускане на пешеходец −10 изпитни т.» under «ОПАСНА ГРЕШКА». The label no longer claims a duty the disc cannot check, so this clause closes on its own terms.

claim: BOTH GREEN TICKS HANDED TO THE RECKLESS DRIVE — the wrong-drive debrief credits ✓«Приближи пътеката с готовност за спиране» 0:31 and ✓«Премини пътеката, след като е свободна» 0:34 on a run with 0 full stops and a 59 км/ч top speed.
why: NOT REPRODUCED AND NOT REFUTED, so it stays open. On w10-3 mobile-wrong/08-debrief-p5.png both objectives carry «–» rather than «✓», but this leg's own run.log refuses the inference in as many words — line 224: «2 objective(s) went UNCREDITED on a drive whose scripted traces never turned the wheel. This instrument cannot tell „the lesson has no drivable success path“ from „this drive could not reach it“», and lines 220-221: «THIS DRIVE WAS NOT STEERED AND NOT MEASURED … every MODE=«wrong» lane … holds the throttle flat». The car booked «Непропускане на пешеходец» and the session ended at 40 s without ever reaching a disc 38 m past the zebra, so the missing ticks are the instrument's silence, not the gate's. A REAL SOURCE REPAIR DID LAND on the first of the two ticks: templates-pe.ts:649 now reads params: { kind: "reachZone", x: LANE_2, y: 68, radiusM: 10, maxSpeedKmh: 30 }, the cap lowered 40 -> 30 so a 59 км/ч approach can no longer certify «готовност за спиране». But no frame in this corpus shows an over-30 drive being denied that tick, and this row has had three closures overturned, so I will not close it on an inference I cannot open. WHAT WOULD CLOSE IT: one STEERED wrong-drive frame showing the approach objective uncredited above 30 км/ч.

claim: The „cross when clear“ objective is authored as pure geometry — {kind:'reachZone', x:LANE_2, y:118, radiusM:12} — it never asks whether the crossing was clear, so it ticks for anyone who drives 38 m further up the road.
why: VERBATIM UNFIXED, and the source says so in its own words. templates-pe.ts:658 is params: { kind: "reachZone", x: LANE_2, y: 118, radiusM: 12 } — character for character the params the parent quotes — sitting under the comment at :656 «Params untouched => `done` is bit-identical», and CLEAR_TITLE_NOTE at :48-72 states the chosen remedy as «NOT ONE PARAM MOVES». The gate still cannot be asked whether the crossing was clear. That the disc is still handed out for merely arriving is visible in the product, not only the source: both steered legs credit it on arrival — w10-3 mobile-right/_audit-debrief.json records «Подмини пътеката и продължи по улицата 1:22» and pc-right records «… 1:23». The title repair banked in child 1 made the label honest about the geometry; it did not give the gate a clearance predicate. WHAT WOULD CLOSE IT: an ObjectiveContext that can see the crossing occupancy, or the objective retired in favour of the rule-engine grader.

claim: On mobile the car never moves for the entire 3.5-minute session: the cluster reads 0 км/ч with gear D at t=065s, t=208s and 07-end, and the scene is byte-identical between them.

why: I opened 04-t024s.png (1,376,787 B) at full size — a real cockpit, windscreen, mirrors, pedal rail — and cropped the instrument cluster to 200%: it reads «11 км/ч» with gear D and the speedo needle visibly lifted off its stop. I sampled the cluster the same way right across the drive: t024 11, t071 13, t126 13, t171 10, t192 12 км/ч, so the car moves repeatedly rather than once. The „byte-identical“ half is false by measurement — md5 of 01-arrival, 04-t066s, 04-t105s, 04-t208s and 07-end are five distinct digests, and the scenes differ by eye: 01-arrival is a straight boulevard with a green car at the right kerb, 04-t105s a different boulevard with a truck alongside, 04-t208s a junction carrying the «Карай дотук» waypoint with a red car at the kerb. run.log:1198 for this leg records «witness path 274.1 m net 274.1 m (straightness 1)» and :1109 «top 19 км/ч · 22 full stops». The frames the parent cites read 0 км/ч because they landed on stops, not because the car was static.

claim: The debrief says the lesson was cut short with nothing scored.
why: VERBATIM TRUE ON THE FRAME. I opened 08-debrief-p1.png (128,905 B): «0 наказателни точки», the amber «НЕЗАВЪРШЕН» pill, and «Изпитният лист остана чист, затова тук не пише „Неиздържан“ … Не пише и „Издържан“ — зачита се само урок, изкаран докрай.» run.log:1207 carries the rest of the same page — «Урокът беше прекъснат преди края.», the class table Опасни 0 / Основни 0 / Второстепенни 0 / Общо 0, and ★☆☆ — and _audit-status.json records endedNaturally=false, forcedBy=«Прекрати урока» after «Ориентировъчно време — 273 с при ориентир 75 с». The student drove 274 m over four and a half minutes and was handed no grade. NOTE FOR WHOEVER PICKS THIS UP: I checked the PC leg of the same lesson myself rather than taking it on trust — run.log:1013 «top 18 км/ч · 24 full stops», :1084 «endedNaturally: true», :1088 «VERDICT: ИЗДЪРЖАН · SCORE: 0 наказателни точки · 3 от 3 звезди», finishing naturally at «214 с при ориентир 75 с» with both objectives ticked (1:52 and 3:33). Same crawl, opposite outcome — so this is the mobile leg's time budget, not the throttle.
